smoothrep.lean
Hi, I developed a short prototype for the basics on smooth representations of a topological group. I hope it serve as preliminary contents on the representations theory of p-adic reductive groups.
It includes definitions of
stabilizer: the stabilizer group fixing a given vector
IsSmoothVector: a vector is smooth if its stabilizer is open
IsSmooth: a representation is smooth if every vector is smooth
SmoothVectors: the subrepresentation of smooth vectors
contragredient: smoothvectors in the dual representation
matrixCoefficient(smooth version): matrix coefficients using smooth dual.
IsSupercuspidal: a notion of supercuspidality

and basic operations and properties:
isSmooth_tprod
isSmooth_sub
isSmooth_quotient
isSmooth_directSum

Before going further, I would appreciate comments on the following:

  1. Is there any duplication from some current project?
  2. Should I split off matrix coefficient and supercuspidal representations into some p-adic project?
  3. Is there any suggestions on the naming and content?
  4. I noticed that there is a notion stabilizer in Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.MulAction, especially some lemmas on the stabilizer of a continuous action on a discrete space. There is also a section about continuous representations. I found it convenient to have a local version of 'stabilizer' in Representation. Should I provide relevant lemmas linking to those content in Mathlib, or is it reasonable to have a purely local definition?

By the way, playing with Subtype consumed me a bit. Concretely speaking,

  1. The proof of 'SmoothVectors_isSmooth' is confusing, where I struggled for quite a while. But mathematically it becomes a tautological statement by the well-definedness of 'SmoothVectors'. So the proof becomes unwrapping definitions with several layers manually. Any suggestion here to make the proof clean?

  2. The same happens in proof of SmoothVectors.apply_mem_toSubmodule: basically the raw goal is not so readable. Is something like
    simp only [Submodule.mem_mk, AddSubmonoid.mem_mk, AddSubsemigroup.mem_mk, mem_setOf_eq,IsSmoothVector]
    unavoidable?

I attached the lean file. Comments are welcome!

At first glance this looks promising. Why not create a new file Mathlib/RepresentationTheory/Stabilizer.lean with the stabilizer material and PR it to mathlib? Some style comments (including spacing comments which might not be relevant becaues I think your cut and pasting mangled some spacing -- usually we just post code using #backticks rather than attaching files): 4 spaces indentation for the statement of a theorem 2 spaces for the proof. Use ← not <-. rw [ not rw[. x * y not x*y. X := Y not X:=Y. If you get these right in the PR then it will save people having to tell you about them (sorry we don't have a formatter yet).
Thanks a lot! I will fix them and try to PR the stabilizer part soon.
